text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research with a primary focus on land use and land cover (LULC) prediction for continental Portugal—a national-scale study area—using Markov chains combined with cellular automata to produce spatially explicit future projections for 2020, 2030, and 2040. It implements and quantitatively compares three distinct future scenarios (environmental sustainability, GDP-driven growth, desertification) alongside a business-as-usual (BAU) baseline. The methodology includes quantitative accuracy assessment (e.g., 9.7% quantity disagreement and 22.4% allocation disagreement), and outputs include mapped LULC projections at national and NUTS 2 regional levels. All core inclusion criteria are satisfied: national-scale implementation, primary LULC prediction focus, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped projections. None of the exclusion criteria apply—the study is not global, local, or methodological without application; it is not species-focused, economic-only, or qualitative; and it goes beyond single-scenario BAU by analyzing multiple alternative futures.)
